## load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(e1071)
library(tm)

# read two data files
artist <- read.csv("artistDf.csv")
songs <- read.csv("billboardHot100_1999-2019.csv")

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## data cleaning and preprocessing

```{r}
artist_clean <- artist %>%
  distinct(Artist, .keep_all = TRUE)

pre_data <- songs %>%
  inner_join(artist_clean, by = c("Artists" = "Artist"))

# filter out non-solo artists and clean lyric text
final_data <- pre_data %>%
  filter(Group.Solo == "Solo") %>%
  mutate(Gender = toupper(trimws(Gender))) %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  distinct(Name, Artists, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\[.*?\\]", ""),
    Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\n", " "),
    Lyrics = str_squish(Lyrics)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lyrics), nchar(Lyrics) > 50) %>%
  mutate(song_id = row_number())

# tokenize lyrics
tokens <- final_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics)

word_totals <- tokens %>%
  count(song_id, name = "word_count")

final_data <- final_data %>%
  left_join(word_totals, by = "song_id")

# count observations by gender at song and artist levels
song_counts <- final_data %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

artist_counts <- final_data %>%
  distinct(Artists, Gender) %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

song_counts
artist_counts
```

## songs by gender

```{r}
gender_counts <- song_counts %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(n, " (", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")"))

gender_counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gender, y = n, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Songs by Artist Gender",
    subtitle = paste("Total sample size:", nrow(final_data)),
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Number of Songs"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#d9487d", "M" = "#4472c4")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))

ggsave("figures/gender_counts.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 200)
```

## overall nrc emotion words

```{r}
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

# use the eight emotion categories from the NRC lexicon
nrc_emotions <- nrc %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("anger", "anticipation", "disgust", "fear", "joy", "sadness", "surprise", "trust"))

emotion_words <- nrc_emotions %>%
  distinct(word)

emotion_by_song <- tokens %>%
  inner_join(emotion_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(song_id, name = "emotion_word_count")

# compute the proportion of all lyric words that are NRC emotion words
emotion_props <- final_data %>%
  select(song_id, Artists, Gender, word_count) %>%
  left_join(emotion_by_song, by = "song_id") %>%
  mutate(emotion_word_count = replace_na(emotion_word_count, 0)) %>%
  mutate(prop_emotion_words = emotion_word_count / word_count)

emotion_props %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_prop = mean(prop_emotion_words),
    median_prop = median(prop_emotion_words),
    sd_prop = sd(prop_emotion_words),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

t.test(prop_emotion_words ~ Gender, data = emotion_props)
wilcox.test(prop_emotion_words ~ Gender, data = emotion_props)
```

## nrc categories by song

```{r}
# match every song and every NRC emotion category
emotion_grid <- final_data %>%
  select(song_id, Artists, Gender, word_count) %>%
  cross_join(nrc_emotions %>% distinct(sentiment))

# count words in each emotion category for each song
emotion_category_counts <- tokens %>%
  inner_join(nrc_emotions, by = "word", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  count(song_id, sentiment, name = "n")

# keep zeroes for songs with no words in a category
emotion_category_song <- emotion_grid %>%
  left_join(emotion_category_counts, by = c("song_id", "sentiment")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_count)

emotion_summary_song <- emotion_category_song %>%
  group_by(Gender, sentiment) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")

emotion_summary_song

plot_song <- emotion_summary_song %>%
  ggplot(aes(sentiment, mean_prop, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Song-Level NRC Emotion-Word Proportion by Gender",
    x = "Emotion category",
    y = "Mean proportion of lyric tokens"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#d9487d", "M" = "#4472c4"))

plot_song
ggsave("figures/emotion_by_gender_song.png", plot = plot_song, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 200)
```

## t tests for nrc categories

```{r}
joy_song <- emotion_category_song %>% filter(sentiment == "joy")
anger_song <- emotion_category_song %>% filter(sentiment == "anger")
fear_song <- emotion_category_song %>% filter(sentiment == "fear")
sadness_song <- emotion_category_song %>% filter(sentiment == "sadness")

joy_artist <- emotion_category_artist %>% filter(sentiment == "joy")
anger_artist <- emotion_category_artist %>% filter(sentiment == "anger")
fear_artist <- emotion_category_artist %>% filter(sentiment == "fear")
sadness_artist <- emotion_category_artist %>% filter(sentiment == "sadness")

# group means
joy_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")
anger_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")
fear_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")
sadness_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")

t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = joy_song)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = anger_song)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = fear_song)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = sadness_song)

t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = joy_artist)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = anger_artist)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = fear_artist)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = sadness_artist)
```

## bing words

```{r}
bing <- get_sentiments("bing")

# same method with bing positive and negative words
bing_grid <- final_data %>%
  select(song_id, Artists, Gender, word_count) %>%
  cross_join(bing %>% distinct(sentiment))

bing_counts <- tokens %>%
  inner_join(bing, by = "word", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  count(song_id, sentiment, name = "n")

bing_song <- bing_grid %>%
  left_join(bing_counts, by = c("song_id", "sentiment")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_count)

positive_song <- bing_song %>% filter(sentiment == "positive")
negative_song <- bing_song %>% filter(sentiment == "negative")

positive_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")
negative_song %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop")

t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = positive_song)
t.test(prop ~ Gender, data = negative_song)
```

## naive bayes

```{r}
set.seed(460)

# binary document-term matrix
songs_dtm <- final_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(song_id, word) %>%
  cast_dtm(song_id, word, n) %>%
  weightBin() %>%
  removeSparseTerms(0.99)

DTM_matrix <- as.matrix(songs_dtm)

labels <- final_data %>%
  filter(song_id %in% as.integer(rownames(DTM_matrix))) %>%
  arrange(match(song_id, as.integer(rownames(DTM_matrix))))

# split the data into training and testing sets
n <- nrow(DTM_matrix)
training_idxs <- sample(1:n, round(n * 0.75))
testing_idxs <- c(1:n)[-training_idxs]

training_set <- DTM_matrix[training_idxs, ]
testing_set <- DTM_matrix[testing_idxs, ]

training_labels <- factor(labels[training_idxs, ]$Gender, levels = c("F", "M"))
testing_labels <- factor(labels[testing_idxs, ]$Gender, levels = c("F", "M"))

naive_bayes <- naiveBayes(training_set, training_labels)
prediction <- predict(naive_bayes, testing_set, type = "class")
prediction <- factor(prediction, levels = c("F", "M"))

# compare predicted labels with the actual testing labels
confusion_matrix <- table(Prediction = prediction, Actual = testing_labels)
confusion_matrix
```

```{r}
# evaluate a confusion matrix for a chosen positive class
evaluate <- function(cm, positive = "M") {
  # true positives, false positives, false negatives, and true negatives
  TP <- cm[positive, positive]
  FP <- sum(cm[positive, ]) - TP
  FN <- sum(cm[, positive]) - TP
  TN <- sum(cm) - TP - FP - FN

  # classification metrics
  precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FP))
  recall <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, NA, TP / (TP + FN))
  f1 <- ifelse(is.na(precision) | is.na(recall) | (precision + recall) == 0, NA, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))

  data.frame(
    positive_class = positive,
    accuracy = (TP + TN) / sum(cm),
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = f1
  )
}

evaluate(confusion_matrix, "M")
evaluate(confusion_matrix, "F")

# majority-class baseline always predicts the most frequent testing label
majority_class <- names(which.max(table(testing_labels)))
baseline_prediction <- factor(rep(majority_class, length(testing_labels)), levels = c("F", "M"))
baseline_matrix <- table(Prediction = baseline_prediction, Actual = testing_labels)

baseline_matrix
evaluate(baseline_matrix, "M")
evaluate(baseline_matrix, "F")
```

## balanced naive bayes

```{r}
set.seed(460)

# downsample male songs so the balanced data has the same number of male and female songs
female_songs <- final_data %>% filter(Gender == "F")
male_songs <- final_data %>% filter(Gender == "M")

male_songs_balanced <- male_songs %>%
  sample_n(nrow(female_songs))

balanced_data <- bind_rows(female_songs, male_songs_balanced) %>%
  sample_frac(1) %>%
  mutate(balanced_id = row_number())

# rebuild the document-term matrix
balanced_dtm <- balanced_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(balanced_id, word) %>%
  cast_dtm(balanced_id, word, n) %>%
  weightBin() %>%
  removeSparseTerms(0.99)

balanced_matrix <- as.matrix(balanced_dtm)

balanced_labels <- balanced_data %>%
  filter(balanced_id %in% as.integer(rownames(balanced_matrix))) %>%
  arrange(match(balanced_id, as.integer(rownames(balanced_matrix))))

n_balanced <- nrow(balanced_matrix)
balanced_training_idxs <- sample(1:n_balanced, round(n_balanced * 0.75))
balanced_testing_idxs <- c(1:n_balanced)[-balanced_training_idxs]

balanced_training_set <- balanced_matrix[balanced_training_idxs, ]
balanced_testing_set <- balanced_matrix[balanced_testing_idxs, ]

balanced_training_labels <- factor(balanced_labels[balanced_training_idxs, ]$Gender, levels = c("F", "M"))
balanced_testing_labels <- factor(balanced_labels[balanced_testing_idxs, ]$Gender, levels = c("F", "M"))

balanced_bayes <- naiveBayes(balanced_training_set, balanced_training_labels)
balanced_prediction <- predict(balanced_bayes, balanced_testing_set, type = "class")
balanced_prediction <- factor(balanced_prediction, levels = c("F", "M"))

# evaluate the balanced model and a balanced majority-class baseline
balanced_matrix_result <- table(Prediction = balanced_prediction, Actual = balanced_testing_labels)
balanced_matrix_result

evaluate(balanced_matrix_result, "M")
evaluate(balanced_matrix_result, "F")

balanced_majority_class <- names(which.max(table(balanced_testing_labels)))
balanced_baseline_prediction <- factor(rep(balanced_majority_class, length(balanced_testing_labels)), levels = c("F", "M"))
balanced_baseline_matrix <- table(Prediction = balanced_baseline_prediction, Actual = balanced_testing_labels)

balanced_baseline_matrix
evaluate(balanced_baseline_matrix, "M")
evaluate(balanced_baseline_matrix, "F")
```
